breadth.label: Percent of S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA
breadth.note: Below 30 bullish, above 70 bearish. Computed by Thaddeus from Yahoo Finance daily closes for 501 of 503 current S&P 500 constituents at the Nov. 2 close (mimics MMFI). Breadth improved even as the cap-weighted S&P fell, reflecting the rotation out of big tech.

fear_greed.commentary: The index slipped into extreme fear at 23 after Monday's session, down from 26 at Friday's close and well below 33 a week ago and 38 a month ago.

markets.summary: Monday's early rally faded as investors kept rotating out of tech: the Nasdaq fell 1.07% and the S&P 500 0.51%, while the Dow rose 0.41% on gains in old-economy names like Sherwin-Williams and Home Depot. Tech stayed under pressure, with Oracle down 8% on plans to raise $20 billion in stock and bonds for its AI buildout and Marvell and Lumentum sliding on their $115 billion merger; the Nasdaq is down 3.8% over the past week and 7.5% over the past month, with RSI near 32 and MACD well below its signal line. Small caps were steadier, with the Russell 2000 off 0.2% to 2,806 but up 0.7% on the week, sitting just under its 40-week average. The 10-year Treasury yield eased to about 4.89%, still up roughly 18% this year. Gold futures bounced 1.8% to about $3,970 and silver futures 3.3% to about $50.72, but both remain below their 40-week averages, with silver down nearly 28% year to date.

stories.headline: SpaceX in talks with EchoStar over Boost Mobile
stories.summary: SpaceX is reportedly discussing buying EchoStar's Boost Mobile or gaining access to its network to build out Starlink Mobile; the stock rose about 4% intraday before closing up 1.2% at $136.37.

stories.headline: SPCX jumps overnight as Musk defends capex efficiency and TSMC Terafab talks resurface
stories.summary: Musk said SpaceX's capital-spending efficiency is greatly underestimated and expects about 1.2 million Nvidia Blackwell chips at Colossus 2 by year-end, while a report pointed to renewed Terafab talks with TSMC.

stories.headline: Key Lake mill outage drove Cameco's Q3 loss and narrower output guidance
stories.summary: Cameco posted a C$2 million adjusted loss and trimmed 2026 production guidance to 19.5 to 20.5 million pounds after an extended Key Lake mill outage; the CEO says the mill has restarted. CCJ fell another 4.6% Monday to $73.38.

stories.headline: Uranium stocks sink despite 18-year high in long-term fuel prices
stories.summary: Uranium miners keep falling even as long-term uranium prices hit their best level in over 18 years, with BMO noting Cameco's Q3 production and sales missed forecasts.

stories.headline: Nvidia's valuation gets torched by the tech rout
stories.summary: After Friday's 4.2% drop, Nvidia trades at about 12.9 times forward earnings, below the S&P 500's 18.7, as investors worry hyperscalers will trim AI capex. Shares closed Monday down 1.3% at $202.06.

stories.headline: Nvidia selloff shows customer spending risk now drives the stock
stories.summary: Investing.com argues the stock is being priced on fears about its customers' cash flow rather than its own results, with the Nov. 17 earnings report (guided to $108 billion revenue) as the next catalyst.

weather.summary: A deepening low tracking into the northern Plains and Upper Midwest drives gusty winds, heavy rain and severe storms, with damaging winds and a few tornadoes possible from south-central Kansas into north-central Oklahoma. Tuesday the severe weather and heavy rain shift into the Middle and Lower Mississippi Valley, reaching the Ohio Valley and Mid-South by Wednesday while a cool, steady rain lingers up north; flooding rain continues along Florida's central and southern east coast.
